# Skill Doctor Lite — Cumulative Web Inc

Skill Doctor Lite is a local-first skill supply-chain linter: point it at
installed AI-agent skill directories and scan SKILL.md and code files for
prompt-injection text, exfiltration lines, approval-disabling instructions,
and embedded secret material — before you install.

- 25-rule versioned catalog (prompt-injection / exfiltration /
  approval-disabling / embedded-secret); every report pins rules_version so a
  "clean" verdict is auditable against the exact rules that produced it.
- Severity-triaged PASS/FAIL verdict — no A–F grades (grading implies a
  scored trust verdict; this tool does triage).
- Exit codes for CI/install-time gates: 0 clean · 1 findings at/above
  --fail-on · 2 usage/IO error.
- Machine-readable JSON reports built for agent consumption.
- Stdlib-only Python, no network, no telemetry. Runs entirely on your machine.

## Honest limits

Signature-based triage, NEVER a certificate of safety. A PASS means no known
signatures matched — it is not proof the skill is safe. Novel attacks,
obfuscation, and non-text payloads are out of scope by design.

## Web demo

The live demo at https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-skill-doctor/ runs
the real engine in your browser — parity-verified finding-for-finding
(33/33) against the Python CLI, including the real test fixtures.

## Run the CLI

    git clone https://github.com/CumulativeWebInc/cwi-skill-doctor.git
    cd cwi-skill-doctor/cli
    python3 -m skill_doctor scan /path/to/skills --format json --fail-on high

## Relationship to Skill Sentinel

Skill Sentinel is the web demo you try in a browser (A–F grades). Skill
Doctor Lite is the tool you wire into your install pipeline — the
CLI/pipeline counterpart, local-first, CI-ready.
